notes.title: Happy (Very Late) New Year 2025!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone! it's a very late message, since l just realized that l can publish news here.

Now l am in China, and it'll be Lunar New Year on 29th Jan. Thinking about this game's release in June (temporarily plan), l feel really excited and also stressed. Can my friends and l really finish developing this game at that time? l have made a schedule but the risks are still uncertain....

Please feel free to ask any questions or express your expectations of this game (though still very few followers now...). We are going to make all our efforts this year!!!
